text.text_excerpt: We live in Mid City just a few minutes bike ride from here, and we have been coming up to get bread from Leo Bread (just across) for quite some time. We noticed that people were ALWAYS coming by to get food and drinks from Pagoda, and decided to grab a late breakfast the other day. Well, that was a game changer, for sure. This place is just killer. First, the folks that work here are so great. Just such nice and welcoming people! That is always nice to have. Second, their coffees are RIGHTEOUS. Seriously, best cold brew I've had in Nola. The Cafe au Lait was good too, according to my wife. Then, the food - the breakfast tacos are really tasty and full of eggs and such, the sausage roll wa...

Such a great, weird little spot with really friendly and thoughtful staff. They also have some really nice outdoor seating for dining outside on a nice day. They have more meat-free and healthy options than you can shake a vegan stick at. Everything I've ever gotten here was fresh and prepared with great care. Try out the mango lassi, the kale turnover, the bacon taco, the ginger tonic, and the curry chicken salad. Also, not sure where their bread comes from, but it's dope.

I've stopped in here a few times for coffee, but mostly I've gone for the tacos. They can take a while if you're there during peak times, so know that before you go. I appreciate the veggies and large portions. Taste and price, and again, veggie options, keep me going back. The coffee is delicious and always fresh. They try to do a lot from scratch here. I can appreciate that! Parking is free on the street, and not usually too hard to find. It's not a place that pops into my head to go out of my way for, but if I'm within a mile or two and need to grab a bite I'll head there for sure.
